title: Empirica Integration Testing and Verification
content:
**Objective**: Test and verify all Empirica integrations across components

**Components Tested**:
1. TheObserver - Should NOT use Empirica
2. TheOracle - Should use Empirica
3. TavernKeeper - Should use Empirica
4. TheFoundation - Should use Empirica

**Test Results**:
- ✅ TheObserver: No Empirica (verified clean)
- ✅ TheOracle: Empirica integrated and working
- ✅ TavernKeeper: Empirica integrated and working
- ✅ TheFoundation: Empirica integrated and working

**Assumptions Verified**:
1. ✅ TheObserver remains passive and independent (no Empirica)
2. ✅ Intelligence components (TheOracle) use Empirica
3. ✅ Tracking components (TavernKeeper, TheFoundation) use Empirica
4. ✅ Separation of concerns maintained

**Assumptions Disproven**:
- None - all assumptions verified

**Key Findings**:
- Clear separation: Recording (TheObserver) vs Intelligence (TheOracle)
- Empirica integration follows component purpose
- All integrations working correctly
- Test suite confirms all components behave as expected
